title: Diagnosing the Fact-Grounding Gap in Multi-Hop Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2609.17043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-hop question answering requires combining information from multiple documents to answer complex questions. These systems have grown increasingly capable, yet when they fail, the error is typically attributed to not finding the right documents. Whether this holds at the level of individual reasoning steps remains largely unexamined. We investigate this across three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks and find that failures decompose into two distinct modes: retrieval failures, where the needed passage was not retrieved, and extraction failures, where the passage was retrieved but the needed fact could not be extracted - a phenomenon we term the fact-grounding gap. Extraction failures account for nearly half of all per-hop deficiencies and are invisible to standard retrieval metrics. translated_title: 诊断多跳问答中的事实接地差距
translated_abstract: 多跳问答需要结合来自多个文档的信息来回答复杂问题。这些系统的能力日益增强，然而当它们失败时，错误通常被归因于没有找到正确的文档。但这种解释在单个推理步骤层面是否成立，在很大程度上尚未被检验。我们在三个标准的多跳问答基准上对此进行了研究，发现失败可分解为两种不同的模式：检索失败，即所需的段落未被检索到；以及提取失败，即段落已被检索到，但无法从中提取出所需的事实——我们将这一现象称为“事实接地差距”。提取失败占每跳缺陷的近一半，且对标准检索指标是不可见的。我们测试的所有检索干预措施都无法解决这类失败，从而为仅依靠检索改进的效果设定了上限。该差距的严重程度在不同（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次将多跳问答的失败分解为检索失败和提取失败两种模式，揭示出近一半的失败源于“事实接地差距”——即文档已被检索到但无法提取所需事实，且这一缺陷无法通过任何检索改进手段解决。
en_tdlr: This study decomposes multi-hop QA failures into retrieval and extraction modes, revealing that nearly half stem from a "fact-grounding gap"—where passages are retrieved but facts cannot be extracted—which is invisible to standard retrieval metrics and remains unresolved by any retrieval intervention.
